about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-shape target. Each input is UTF-8 text (invalid sequences are replaced), optionally followed by a 0xFF byte and a font or font recipe as font-read takes it; without a usable font the text is shaped with Inter. scripts/run_fuzz.py also adds each real font from tests/fonts/ and tests/corpus/ after a short text and the 0xFF marker.

parts.text: office affine ffi ffl fl fi

seeds.why: Inter's contextual asterisk raised beside capitals
accents, punctuation, an emoji and a combining mark
invalid UTF-8: lone continuation, truncated sequence, surrogate encoding
text with the synthetic sample font, which has every lookup kind
text with Inter through a recipe
text with a font that cannot be read: falls back to Inter
marker with no text and no font
